wholeCurrentGoal.title: Genetische Neukombination und Biodiversität verknüpfen
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Zusammenhang zwischen genetischen Neukombinationsprozessen und der Evolution bisheriger sowie zukünftiger Biodiversität erklären.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the relationship between genetic recombination processes and the evolution of past and future biodiversity.

rows.scienceAndGeometryReasoning: The input shows two duplicated homologues: both maternal sisters carry upper yellow/lower green bands; both paternal sisters carry upper purple/lower yellow bands. The center now has four separate continuous vertical schematic chromatid paths with four distinct centromere circles and four complete upper/lower arms. From left to right they carry Y/G, Y/Y, P/G, P/Y. Only the middle red and blue non-sisters have swapped their lower segments and lower-locus marker bands reciprocally; their upper bands and both outer nonparticipating sisters remain. Two dotted opposed arrows explicitly mark that segment exchange. No merged pseudo-chiasma or misplaced upper-locus purple band remains. The right output regroups, rather than preserves positional order: the first bracket contains Y/G and P/Y parental combinations; the second contains Y/Y and P/G recombinant combinations. All four marker combinations and per-locus allele inventories agree. This is a symbolic reciprocal segment-exchange diagram, not a literal paired-chromosome/chiasma micrograph or a complete meiosis stage drawing.
rows.actualReadabilityReasoning: Original and680 show four distinct center paths, the two arrows, upper/lower marker positions and parental/recombinant brackets clearly. At360 the main headings and core marker topology/counts remain visible; small lower labels require normal larger viewing but remain secondary to the large diagram. No essential scientific distinction depends on tiny nucleotide text. The image is a16:9 comic-style landscape with high contrast and no watermark.
rows.perspectiveAndScopeLimits: No actor or handwriting perspective is involved. The butterflies and dotted arrow represent a conceptual contribution to variation and biodiversity. A single illustrated crossover does not create new allele variants or establish immediate speciation, actual future population evolution, a real observed meiosis event, a worked learner explanation or experiment. The visually unchanged parental/recombinant categories are correctly separated; the full bilingual goal includes evolutionary interpretation that still requires assessable learner work.
rows.goalFit: Matches the unchanged whole DE/EN recombination/biodiversity goal as bounded didactic visual candidate; current native resource/page and P/source/course gates remain separate.

preFirstDisclosure: Parent neutral handoff described author intent as a schematic reciprocal segment exchange; no actual author inspection or fresh peer verdict was read. This judgment is based on the actual three views and finite marker reconstruction.
